scores.evidence: No hard failures: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image errors, and no text-only screens. The cycle-flow diagram (flowchart TD) is readable at 390 px, and the steps, prompts and quizzes are laid out cleanly. Three problems: the highlighted hook command in ex-settings is cut off on both desktop and mobile, the third table column of dr-table is off-screen on mobile, and one diagram node breaks inside レビューする.

Text never runs long without a break. Every screen has a heading, steps, a prompt, code or a quiz, and the four inline checks are evenly spaced (mobile-jp-04, 11, 21, 23). The long prompt blocks (setup-prompt-model, ex-prompt-skill) fill about two mobile screens each, but they are structured, so this is acceptable.

The Japanese UI and content are consistent, the diagram labels are in Japanese, contrast is good and no controls are hidden under the bars. On mobile the dr-table column 学んだ回 can only be reached by a side scroll that has no visible hint, and the first segment of ex-settings line 4 and line 13 is unreadable without scrolling.

mustFix.issue: Highlighted line 13 (the PostToolUse hook command) is cut off at the right edge on desktop (it ends at '...xargs npx prettier', so '--write' is hidden) and on mobile (it ends at "jq -r '.tool_in"). Line 4, the deny array, is also cut off on mobile. These are highlighted key lines that the learner cannot read without scrolling sideways.
mustFix.fix:
Put the deny entries one per line, as setup-settings-model already does ("deny": [
 "Read(./.env)",
 "Read(./.env.*)"
]). Also write the full hook command in the ex-hook step md, for example: 「コマンドは `jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs npx prettier --write` です」. That way the learner can read it without scrolling the code block.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px only two of the three columns fit. The column 学んだ回 (第6回/第7回/第8回) is off-screen to the right with no visible scroll hint, and the 'サブエージェント' cell is clipped at the edge.
mustFix.fix: Reduce the table to 2 columns by moving the lesson number into the part cell, for example 'CLAUDE.mdに1行足す（第6回）', 'スキル（第7回）', 'サブエージェント（第7回）', and drop the 学んだ回 column.

mustFix.issue: The node label '別のコンテキストでレビューする' wraps inside the word, as 'レビュー' / 'する', on both desktop and mobile.
mustFix.fix:
Insert an explicit break at the phrase boundary: C["別のコンテキストで
レビューする
（サブエージェント）"].

niceToHave: reader: the desktop JP charsPerLine median is 42 (max 56) against the 30–40 target at a 680 px measure. Consider a narrower text column or a larger font for JP.
reader: horizontally scrollable tables and code blocks on mobile give no visual cue (fade or shadow) that more content is to the right.

The long lesson subtitle and the 10-item prerequisites line form a dense grey block at the top of mobile-jp-01. Shortening the prerequisites (e.g. '第2〜10回の内容、Gitのcommit、試せるリポジトリ') would make the opening screen lighter.

In ex-steps ⑤ on mobile, the '、' after `.claude/settings.json` wraps to the start of a line (mobile-jp-07). Rewording to 'CLAUDE.md と `.claude/settings.json`、`.claude/skills/` を…' or using 'と' would avoid it.
summary: The lesson ID is cc-11-capstone and the lessonHash in metrics.json matches the given sha256:054759c1db95b6c4. There are no hard failures and no personal data appears on any screen. The layout is clean, the vertical cycle diagram is readable at 390 px, and checks are well spaced. The most important fix is the example settings.json (ex-settings): its highlighted hook command is cut off even on desktop. The mobile table (dr-table) also needs to drop to 2 columns, and one diagram label needs a break at the phrase boundary.
